items.body: الهزيمة من الاتحاد تربك العالمي أثارت خسارة النصر أمام الاتحاد ردود فعل واسعة، لكن المفاجأة جاءت هذه المرة من أحد أبرز نجوم العالمي السابقين، بعدما جدد توقعه بشأن هوية بطل دوري روشن السعودي رغم مرور خمس جولات فقط من عمر المسابقة. وتمسك فهد الهريفي، نجم النصر السابق، بترشيحه للهلال للفوز بلقب الدوري السعودي هذا الموسم، مؤكدًا أن تعثر فريقه أمام الاتحاد لم يغير قناعته التي أعلنها قبل انطلاق الموسم. وخسر النصر أمام الاتحاد بنتيجة 2-1، في الكلاسيكو الذي جمع الفريقين مساء السبت ضمن الجولة الخامسة من دوري روشن. وفي تصريحات تلفزيونية، عبر برنامج "دورينا غير" أكد الهريفي أنه لن يتراجع عن توقعه. وقال: "قلتها من نهاية الموسم الماضي، وبداية الموسم الحالي حسمتها بأن الهلال هو بطل الدوري للسنة الحالية. ومن يعرفني يعلم أنني لا أغير أقوالي، وبالطبع ما زلنا في بدايات المنافسة لكن الأمور تبدو واضحة". وأكد الهريفي أن رأيه لا يتعلق بنتيجة مباراة الاتحاد، مؤكدا أن تقلبات مستوى النصر في أواخر الموسم الماضي، ومنحه الفرصة للهلال للعودة للمنافسة، وراء هذا التوقع. تذاكر مباريات دوري روشن السعودي اشترِ تذكرتك الآنَ!   فهد الهريفي : انا قلت من نهاية الموسم الماضي وأكررها #الهلال بطل دوري هذا الموسم … #الاتحاد_النصر #دورينا_غير pic.twitter.com/omOMgZYSx4 — خالد الشنيف (@k_alshenaif) September 5, …

items.summary: قمة البريميرليج
items.body: قمة البريميرليج لا تحمل الآلة أية عواطف أو مشاعر، لذلك قرر كووورة توجيه عدة أسئلة جدلية للذكاء الاصطناعي، واستعراض الإجابات دون تدخل تحريري. والسؤال الذي نطرحه في حلقة اليوم من السلسلة يثير شغف مشجعي كرة القدم في الوقت الحالي، وهو: "ما النتيجة المتوقعة لمباراة آرسنال وتشيلسي في الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز ؟". (ملحوظة): جميع الإجابات، بما يمكن أن تتضمنه من أخطاء لغوية أو معلوماتية، أوردناها كما ذكرها الذكاء الاصطناعي. الإجابة: النتيجة المتوقعة لمباراة آرسنال ضد تشيلسي اليوم هي فوز آرسنال بنتيجة 2-1. الشرح والأسباب المتوقعة عامل الأرض والجمهور: تُقام المباراة على ملعب الإمارات، حيث يمتلك آرسنال سجلاً قوياً أمام جماهيره في ديربيات لندن، وكانت مواجهتهما الأخيرة على هذا الملعب قد انتهت بفوز آرسنال بالنتيجة ذاتها 2 - 1. الاستقرار والجاهزية الفنية: يدخل آرسنال المواجهة بترشيحات أعلى لحصد النقاط كاملة وتصدر المنافسة، بفضل التنظيم الدفاعي الممتاز وقدرته على استغلال الكرات الثابتة والضغط العالي. الخطورة الهجومية لتشيلسي: يمتلك تشيلسي عناصر هجومية قادرة على اختراق الدفاعات وتسجيل هدف في اللقاء، إلا أن الفاعلية التهديفية والاستقرار التكتيكي لآرسنال يُرجّحان كفته لحسم الديربي ببهدفين مقابل هدف. يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات "كووورة"

Aggro Crab is still down to zig and not zag, though, and will be publishing and supporting a very different sort of game, the upcoming platformer Rebounder. It's tough enough to stand out in the games market these days, let alone as a 2D platformer, so I'm always excited when one really breaks through and catches my eye. But the game's legendary co-creator, Tarn Adams, didn't even know it had a big following for many years, as he told PC Gamer's Joshua Wolens in a recent interview at Gamescom 2026 . "It was something like 2013, 14 going to PAX in Seattle, and there was an indie mega booth at the time," he recalled. "Of the 50 or 60 games showing—I'm just ballparking the numbers—I'd say 90% of them heard of Dwarf Fortress and also had a very amazed fan-ish response when we were introduced." items.body: As reported by The Korea Economic Daily , top-ranked Go grandmaster Shin Jin-seo became the first human to defeat the AI platform KataGo on July 21. It's a surprising, encouraging sign of human capabilities almost 30 years after supercomputer Deep Blue's historic defeat of Chess grandmaster Garry Kasparov. Go is believed to be the oldest board game that is still widely played, originating in China and beating out Chess by at least 1400 years, give or take. The strategy game sees players in control of different-colored stones, working to encircle their opponent's pieces, capturing territory and stones to achieve victory. Like Chess, its complexity, ubiquity, and the large amount of study and data surrounding the game made Go a fruitful tool for machine learning research. Shin, 26, is the first human to win an official, three-game series against KataGo, which the Korea Economic Daily described as "the world's premier artificial intelligence Go engine." items.body: I love lockpicking minigames, especially when representatively they're as far away from the act of lockpicking as possible. While I admire the elegance of Bethesda's bobby-pin/screwdriver system seen in Fallout 4 , I'm much more interested in the weirder solutions like Splinter Cell 's baffling pin-flicking system, or Gothic Remake 's absurdly elaborate sliding puzzle system. I love how developers have tried so many ways to represent the act of lockpicking, and that despite this nobody has 'solved' the problem of virtual lockpicking yet (though Bethesda has arguably come closest). Inevitably, then, I was drawn to the idea of a game that is all about lockpicking. But I never expected that it could be as imaginative and thrilling as Lockpicks-11 . Yet rather than being a fully fledged burglary simulator like Thief, Lockpicks-11 distils the act of larceny to a linear sequence of locked doors. items.body: The way our hobby talks about player counts is all sorts of messed up. Steam concurrents are a useful metric for gauging a game's general popularity, but they paint an incomplete picture. They're a single data point, yet have become the flimsy scaffolding on which the internet builds elaborate headcanon about a game's quality, viability, or deadness. Sometimes dogpiling is so successful, and the resulting perception so difficult to fight, that simply saying a game is dead is enough to help kill it. It's a trend that annoys me to no end, so it's refreshing to see a developer speaking openly about concurrents—both about how many it considers "healthy," and why it's normal for the number to rise and fall. A new homebrew app has been released on Github that will allow you to run the DLSS Neural Rendering feature on a Radeon GPU. I've tried it and it works, but damn does it hurt the poor Radeon silicon. From having DLSS 5 .dll files plucked from an early access version of NBA 2K27, we've had modders working hard to create surprisingly polished ways to essentially get the tech working in practically any game , even if it doesn't natively support traditional DLSS itself. items.title: Silent Hill: Townfall is the most Scottish game I've ever played and the most effective horror game I've seen in ages: 'It made sense for us to dig deep into our upbringings, into our past, and try and build a place that felt believable'
items.summary: And not just because of the foul weather.
items.body: Silent Hill has gone international. Last year we went to Japan in Silent Hill f , and now the series is off to Scotland in Silent Hill: Townfall . As a middle-aged Scot who still remembers the '90s, when Townfall takes place, I was simultaneously nervous and excited about the rare opportunity to play a game that's so close to home. What a relief, then, that Townfall not only feels incredibly Scottish, its Scottishness also perfectly matches Silent Hill's brand of unsettling psychological horror. items.summary: The trench coat is actually integral to the build.
items.body: What's the weirdest bit of Resident Evil lore you know of? Is it the fact that Claire Redfield's favourite food is a cheeseburger? Maybe it's that Hunk spent a week lost in Raccoon City's sewers eating rats after getting his ass beaten by Birkin? Or perhaps it's that the Tyrant's trench coat is more than just a bold fashion statement—it's actually integral to the build. There's been a few explanations as to why Tyrants wear trench coats in Resident Evil games. One perk of the coat is that it helps disguise the mutations, which allows Tyrants to infiltrate more sensitive areas, but its biggest bonus is its power-limiting function. Wearing the trench coat holds the Tyrant together by preventing out-of-control mutations, and if it's damaged or the Tyrant removes it you'll get a Super Tyrant.
